personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean fused with 5 Brutalist precision (Monospace typography for hashes, strict structural borders, utility-first layouts)
personality_one_liner: The trust layer for AI—a precise, structured, and immutable environment that feels like modern security infrastructure and enterprise developer tooling.

spacing.rule: Generous structural padding on screens. Cards use md (12px) internal padding. Maintain strict hierarchy with consistent gaps.

do's: Avoid glass entirely to maintain the solid, secure, structural 'developer infrastructure' aesthetic.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism on tab bars, headers, or cards. Use solid surfaceSecondary or borders instead.

screens.name: Home (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: Provides high-level workspace overview, limits, and primary action to capture a new record.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for metrics and recent records.
states.empty: Empty state illustration of a secure vault, 'No records yet', and a primary 'Create Record' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load records banner with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Header with user profile/settings. Metric cards (total records, trial limit 10). A prominent sticky 'Create Record' FAB or bottom CTA. A list of recent records underneath with Record ID (monospace) and timestamps.

screens.name: Create Record
screens.purpose: Select the capture method for the conversation.

states.error: Microphone permission error or API failure.

screens.layout: Grid or vertical stack of 3 distinct cards (Record Mic, Phone Call, Paste Transcript). Each card uses surfaceSecondary with a subtle border and Phosphor icon. Clean, tool-like interaction.

screens.name: Metadata & Consent
screens.purpose: Form to tag the agent/conversation and confirm legal consent.

states.error: Validation errors on required fields with red outline.

screens.layout: Single column form. Labels above inputs. Segmented control or dropdowns for Agent Name and Conversation Type (Sales/Support/Billing). Explicit checkbox for Consent. Sticky 'Proceed' CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Transcript Review
screens.purpose: Review and manually edit extracted transcript before committing.
screens.layout: Full-height text area with monospace or highly readable sans-serif typography. Floating action button or sticky bottom bar to 'Extract Commitments'.

screens.name: Conversation Receipt
screens.purpose: The core trust document showing immutable evidence, hash, and extracted commitments.
screens.layout: Receipt-style layout. Top header with 'Verified' green badge or 'Mismatch' red badge. Monospace typography for Record ID (RCP-2026-000001) and SHA-256 hash block. Extracted commitment cards highlighting quotes. 'Verify Integrity' secondary button and 'Export Evidence' sticky primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Records History
screens.purpose: Searchable archive of all logged receipts.
screens.layout: Search bar pinned at the top. Flat list of record cards. Each card displays ID, Date, Agent, and status badge.

screens.name: Pricing / Upgrade
screens.purpose: Showcase premium plans for users exceeding trial limits.
screens.layout: Carousel or stacked list of tier cards (Grey Parrot, Myna, Enterprise). Emphasize features with checkmarks. Dark mode aesthetic here can emphasize premium/security feel.

screens.name: Google Login
screens.purpose: Single Sign-On access to the business workspace.
screens.layout: Centered logo (blue/purple neon 'RA' monogram), tagline 'Prove What Your AI Promised', and a standard Google SSO button. Minimalist, high-contrast.

logo_neon_ra.alt: blue/purple neon 'RA' monogram with an audio waveform on a black background

home_empty_vault.alt: Minimalist vector illustration of a secure digital vault or lock, representing immutable data storage

verification_success_seal.alt: Cryptographic checkmark seal indicating a verified SHA-256 hash

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette which leverages deep navy, charcoal, neutral gray, and a restrained indigo/blue accent as requested by the user. Do not introduce generic AI 'sparkle' purple/pink gradients.

Implement the 'Geist Mono' (or equivalent monospace) font for all Record IDs, SHA-256 hashes, timestamps, and technical identifiers. This is critical for the 'developer infrastructure / security software' aesthetic.
Component styling: Cards should have radius 'md' (12px), background 'surfaceSecondary', and a subtle 1px border. Shadows should be minimal (tier 1) or completely removed in favor of borders.

Conversation Receipt Screen: Design this to feel like an invoice or a GitHub commit. Use a distinct block (perhaps surfaceTertiary with mono text) to display the SHA-256 hash. Incorporate clear success/mismatch status banners at the top of the receipt.
Disable glassmorphism/blur entirely. Security tools prioritize clarity, contrast, and solid surfaces over cinematic translucent effects.

Layouts should follow a single-column, structured flow with labels above inputs, avoiding floating labels. Use a sticky CTA anchored at the bottom of scrollable screens like 'Metadata' and 'Create Record'.

Ensure 'Dark Mode' is highly polished. The user specifically noted the app should feel like a modern security software tool, where dark mode (using deep obsidian and charcoal) often serves as the primary visual identity.
